metadata.name: sheetsync.commit
metadata.description: (state, seg, key, source) -> {ok, hash, layers}. The CRDT change pipeline (Phase 3): gate the author (writableBy), diff the segment SOURCE string before->after the edit, crdt.layer + keystore.sign, verify the signature + re-gate the signer, crdt.append to <seg>.crdt, fold the stack -> source cels (setCel) + runCycle (derived recompute locally), then stamp <seg>.hash. SOURCES only; one writer at a time; non-writers dropped. Loopback now; Phase 4 puts the op on a WebRTC channel.

metadata.name: sheetsync.connect
metadata.description: (state) -> {ok, frame}. Register inbound frame routes (op/key/hello -> sheetsync.recv) on the peer transport and emit a 'hello' announcing my identity + ecdh pub so a peer can wrap a data key to me. Returns the hello frame (for tests to hand-deliver).

metadata.name: sheetsync.share
metadata.description: (state, seg, peerEcdhPub?) -> {ok, frame}. Grant a peer access to a synced segment: mint the segment data key if absent, ECDH-wrap it to the peer's ecdh pub (keystore.wrapTo), and send a 'key' frame carrying { wrapped key, writers list, encrypted current op-log }. The data key + op-log travel encrypted; writers are public identities. Returns the key frame.

metadata.name: sheetsync.recv
metadata.description: (state, frame) -> decision string. The inbound dispatch (peer.route target). hello -> record peer ecdh; key -> unwrap data key + adopt writers + fold the shared op-log; op -> decrypt with the segment data key, verify signature, gate writableBy, append + fold. SOURCES only; non-writers + bad signatures dropped.

metadata.name: sheetsync.haskey
metadata.description: (state, seg) -> boolean. Non-secret introspection: is this segment being synced (a data key is held in module scope)? The key itself is NEVER a cel.

metadata.name: sheetsync.hello
metadata.description: (state) -> {ok, frame}. (Re)announce presence: emit a hello carrying my identity + ecdh pub so a peer can wrap a data key to me. Registered as peer's 'open' handler so it fires when the data channel opens.

metadata.name: peers
metadata.description: reactive list of present peers [{id, ecdh}] (both PUBLIC keys), maintained from inbound hello frames. The UI reads this for presence + as grant targets. The per-segment data key stays module-scope, never here.

metadata.name: room
metadata.description: the live collaboration room currently joined (set by sheetapp.golive via peerjoin). Empty when offline.

metadata.name: relay
metadata.description: the WebSocket signaling relay URL used by sheetapp.golive to broker peer discovery (peerjoin a room). Overridable per deployment; default localhost dev relay.
